title: Return JSON for unexpected errors in the order routes
description: When an order route fails unexpectedly, clients get Next's HTML error page, which the mobile app cannot read. Adds `withErrors` in `src/lib/http.ts`, which logs the error and answers a JSON 500, and wraps GET and POST /api/orders with it. Includes tests and a README note.

comments.issue: The 500 response sends the raw error message and stack trace to the client: Prisma messages include queries, table and column names and sometimes values, and the stack shows server paths. Log the details and send a generic message.
